title: DOJ didn't sell Bitcoin forfeited from Samourai case: White House advisor
summary: Selling the Bitcoin would have violated President Donald Trump’s Executive Order 14233, which mandates that any Bitcoin obtained through criminal or civil forfeiture “shall not be sold.”

title: DOJ Did Not Sell Forfeited Samourai Bitcoin, White House Crypto Advisor Says
summary: A White House crypto advisor said the US government has not sold any Bitcoin forfeited in the Samourai Wallet case.The postDOJ Did Not Sell Forfeited Samourai Bitcoin, White House Crypto Advisor Saysappeared first onCryptonews.

title: Bitcoin Seized From Samourai Wallet Has Not Been Sold, White House Says
summary: Advocates for the incarcerated Samourai Wallet developers have argued that the DOJ liquidated the Bitcoin funds against the president’s wishes.
